title: NISQ Readiness: Predeclared Evaluation Plan
purpose: This document records an author-declared evaluation plan for the campaign. It specifies the workload matrix, metrics, decision rules, and reporting posture so a reader can inspect the declared plan rather than only the final narrative.

v1_0.description: Core evidence posture + CHSH entanglement-witness case study.
v1_0.backends_note: If a listed backend is unavailable, record the substitution explicitly in the manifest; do not silently swap.

v1_1_S1.description: Workload expansion to address toy-workload critiques.

v1_1_S2.description: Confirmatory stage at elevated shot count.
v1_1_S2.workload_subset: mirror_1q (5 depths) + ghz_7 + rand_w6_d16 (4 seeds) = 10 kinds

chsh_S.definition: CHSH parameter S = E(a0b0) + E(a0b1) + E(a1b0) - E(a1b1), where E is the parity correlation computed from per-setting bitstring distributions.

mirror_return_probability.definition: P(0) from the output distribution of a mirror circuit that should return to |0>.

ghz_parity_success.definition: P(0^n) + P(1^n) from the output distribution of a GHZ-state preparation.

grover_target_hit.definition: P(1^n) from the output distribution of a Grover search circuit.

qft_entropy.definition: Shannon entropy H = -sum(p*log2(p)) of the output distribution. Ideal QFT on n qubits produces a uniform distribution with H = n bits.

random_collision.definition: Collision probability sum(p^2) of the output distribution. Smaller values indicate flatter (more uniform) distributions.

chsh_claim_gate.rule: Assert 'CHSH violation observed' ONLY when BOTH conditions are met: (1) S > 2.0, AND (2) CI95_low > 2.0 (95% confidence interval lower bound exceeds classical limit).
chsh_claim_gate.headline_requires: Replicates on >= 2 backends OR >= 2 independent runs with declared stopping rules.
chsh_claim_gate.negative_control: Include at least one product-state (non-entangled) circuit; it must FAIL the claim gate.

general_reporting.rule: All metrics are reported as measurement summaries, not universal claims. Negative and partial results are first-class outputs.
general_reporting.stopping_rule: Stop expanding shots/backends when CI width targets are met or budget limits are hit; record stopping rationale.

uncertainty.method: Approximate binomial: SE(E) = sqrt((1 - E^2) / N), SE(S) = sqrt(sum(SE(E_i)^2)), CI95 = S +/- 1.96 * SE(S).
uncertainty.note: This approximation is used for transparent sanity checks; production analysis may use stricter resampling.

non_claims: We do NOT claim 'new physics,' loophole-free Bell tests, or determinism of measurement outcomes.
We do NOT claim provider-signed attestation unless the provider explicitly signs an artifact we publish.
We do NOT claim universal performance improvements across devices/backends; results are measurements tied to declared workloads and runs.

analysis_additions_v2.noise_model_comparison: Depolarizing gate+readout model comparison against observed CHSH S values (Eq. S_noisy = 2sqrt(2)(1-eps_2q)(1-2*eps_ro)^2). Note: v1 of this field incorrectly showed (1-eps_2q)^2; corrected in v4 to reflect single CX gate.
analysis_additions_v2.bootstrap_ci_validation: Non-parametric bootstrap (B=10000) validation of IID confidence intervals for all 33 CHSH runs
analysis_additions_v2.cross_backend_correlation: Pairwise Spearman rank correlations of workload difficulty across all 6 backends
analysis_additions_v2.readout_mitigation: M3-style readout error mitigation applied to ibm_torino CHSH runs as diagnostic
analysis_additions_v2.scaling_analysis: GHZ parity exponential decay fit P(n) = A(1-2p)^n for per-qubit error extraction
